## Research interests

Computational methods for spatial transcriptomics, cell-cell communication, and subcellular gene expression.

## Current project

::: {.research-panel}
[In progress]{.panel-label}

### Bringing the endoplasmic reticulum into cell-cell interaction prediction

Many of the signals cells send to each other, such as secreted ligands, are made in the endoplasmic reticulum (ER) before they leave the cell. Most methods for predicting cell-cell interactions ignore where inside a cell a gene is expressed, so they miss this ER-specific information.

I am developing a method that estimates ER-specific gene expression in spatial transcriptomics datasets that have no ER staining. It works from the local density of known ER-enriched secretome genes, and I benchmark it against datasets where ER staining is available. The goal is to use this ER signal to make cell-cell interaction predictions more accurate.

**Keywords:** spatial transcriptomics · subcellular localization · endoplasmic reticulum · secretome · cell-cell communication
:::
